description: Codex operating-layer learning events shared by Git hooks, local gates, PR watchers, and MAIP memory ingestion.

storage_model.r2: large logs and reports when promoted by a later worker flow

reliability_rules: Always append locally before attempting remote sync.
Remote sync is best-effort unless a caller explicitly requests strict sync.
Event IDs are used for dedupe during outbox flush.
Payloads sent to MAIP memory must avoid secrets, URLs, customer facts, and raw logs.
